answer: To register, an agent locks an NFT held as collateral as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. An agent caught grading peers far from the panel verdict faces proof via consensus scoring of grades. When the proof lands, the bond is slashed in tiers: ten percent first offence, fifty percent second, all of it third. The echo is where slashable funds wait for a verdict. A ferrous deposit cannot split across identities. No whisper means no registration: the bond comes first.
